summary: StoryFy Admin Portal Phase 3 - All features tested and passing. Backend APIs (10 tests) passed 100%. Frontend UI verified for playable project viewer with Web Audio API controls and Usage Logs page with 3 tabs (Limit Transactions, Admin Actions, Analytics).

TestUsageTransactions.test_get_transactions_with_admin_token: PASSED - Returns enriched transactions with user_email, user_name

TestUsageActions.test_get_actions_with_admin_token: PASSED - Returns enriched admin actions with admin_email, admin_name

TestProjectViewerEndpoint.test_get_episode_project_returns_audio_d: PASSED - Returns tracks with clips containing audio URLs for playback

admin_login.details: Admin login with admin@admin.com/admin123 works correctly

usage_nav_link.details: Usage nav link appears in header on all admin pages (Dashboard, Stories, Project Viewer)

usage_logs_page_load.details: Usage Logs page loads at /admin-access/usage with 3 tabs

limit_transactions_tab.details: Shows table with Date, User, Type, Amount, Balance, Description columns. Color-coded badges: signup_bonus=green, admin_add=cyan, admin_deduct=orange

admin_actions_tab.details: Shows table with Date, Admin, Action, Target, Details columns. Found 10 admin action rows

analytics_tab.details: Shows transaction summary cards (signup_bonus, admin_add, admin_deduct), daily signups chart, top creators table

search_filter.details: Search filter works on Transactions and Actions tabs. Filtering 'adjust' narrowed actions to 4 rows

project_viewer_transport_controls.details: Play/Pause, Stop, Rewind buttons present and functional

project_viewer_playhead.details: Playhead element present and moves during playback/seeking

project_viewer_time_ruler_seek.details: Clicking time ruler seeks to that position (clicked middle, time became 0:30.00)

project_viewer_zoom_controls.details: Zoom In/Out buttons present with 1.00x default zoom

project_viewer_readonly_badge.details: Read-Only badge displayed confirming no editing capabilities

project_viewer_tracks_clips.details: 3 tracks (Voice Track 1, Background Music, Sound Effects) displayed with 1 clip visible

critical_code_review_comments: Web Audio API implementation in AdminProjectViewer.js is well structured with proper cleanup on unmount
Usage Logs page uses efficient parallel API fetching for all 3 data sources
Admin-only endpoints properly protected with require_admin dependency returning 403 for non-admins
Analytics aggregation pipelines in server.py are efficient using MongoDB's aggregation framework
Color-coded transaction type badges improve data readability
seed_data_creation: None - used existing limit_transactions and admin_actions from Phase 1 testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Portal Phase 3 complete. New APIs: GET /api/admin-9821/usage/transactions (enriched with user_email/user_name), GET /api/admin-9821/usage/actions (enriched with admin_email/admin_name), GET /api/admin-9821/usage/analytics (aggregated daily_signups, transactions_by_type, top_creators). New frontend route: /admin-access/usage with 3 tabs. Project viewer at /admin-access/projects/:episodeId now has playback controls using Web Audio API but remains read-only (no editing).

api_endpoints_tested.notes: Returns limit transactions enriched with user_email, user_name
Returns admin actions enriched with admin_email, admin_name
Returns aggregated analytics: daily_signups, daily_generations, transactions_by_type, top_creators
Returns project_state with tracks/clips containing audio URLs for playback
